Builders FirstSource acquires L&P Building Supply
November 13, 2026 | 9:10 am CST
Builders FirstSource acquires L&P Building Supply
L&P operates a full-service lumberyard and an on-site truss and wall panel manufacturing facility. Photo by Builders FirstSource.
Builders FirstSource announced the company has acquired L&P Building Supply in Las Cruces, NM.

L&P serves customers in southern New Mexico and El Paso, Texas, with lumber, building materials, and manufactured components including trusses and wall panels. The addition extends BFS’ network in New Mexico, where it already operates lumberyards in Albuquerque, Farmington, Santa Fe, Angel Fire and Raton, along with component manufacturing operations in Albuquerque.

“M&A activity in the lumber and building materials sector remains strong despite interest-rate headwinds. Acquirers continue to seek well-run companies like L & P Building Supply,” said Managing Director John Wagner. “Strong LBM businesses continue to attract buyer interest, even in challenging markets. We were honored to advise L&P on this successful sale.”
The newest acquisition joins Gleckler & Sons, Innovative Construction Group, Precision Design and Trim, and Premium Building Components, all of which joined BFS this year.
